canonical_project: DTS trans-Saharan fiber project - Bol technical site
owner: DTS (Dorsale Transsaharienne a fibre optique) project - Ministry of Telecommunications; EU-funded (EUR 29m); contractor for technical-site construction
notes: Inspection mission (11 Jan 2026) found significant degradations at the DTS technical site of Bol (Lac province): windows of the building meant to host technical equipment/materials broken, compromising installation security; contractor ordered to reinforce security. DTS works (launched 2023) delayed due to control-mission mobilization issues. Classified telecom transmission/technical site infrastructure, NOT a commercial data center.
